filtros.notaVenezuela: Mainland and islands, earthquakes 50 km or less off the coast, and the disputed zone, each with its label.
filtros.notaRegion: The whole rectangle queried from the USGS: includes neighboring countries and the sea.
frescura.estado.atencion: At least one daily update was missed
aviso.noAlerta: This dashboard is educational and informational. It is not an early-warning system: it does not detect earthquakes as they happen, send alerts or predict earthquakes, and must not be used for safety, evacuation or emergency decisions. If you feel an earthquake, follow your local official protocols.
aviso.funvisis: Data comes from the USGS global catalog. The reference network in Venezuela is FUNVISIS, which may report a different magnitude, epicenter or depth for the same event. Only the USGS version is shown here, not averaged or corrected.
aviso.desfase: The catalog is refreshed once a day: an event may take 24 hours or more to appear, and the USGS may revise events later.
aviso.territorio: “Venezuela only” includes the geoBoundaries land polygon with islands, a 50 km band off its coast (outside other countries' land) and the disputed zone of Guayana Esequiba, labeled separately with Natural Earth’s classification. The project takes no political position.
tabla.caption: Visible earthquakes, newest first. Showing {n} of {total}.
territorio.costa: Off the Venezuelan coast (50 km or less)
stats.nota: Computed with the current filters ({n} earthquakes). Change the zone, years or magnitude under “Filters”.
hist.aria: Histogram of earthquakes per year, from {desde} to {hasta}. An equivalent table is available for screen readers.
top.nota: Ties go to the most recent first. Magnitude as published by the USGS.
cerca.nota: We do not ask for your location: you pick the city. Straight-line distance from the city to the epicenter; it does not measure how strongly the quake was felt.
cerca.ninguno: No earthquakes within {radio} km of {ciudad} with these filters.
ficha.sinEnlace: This event has no link to its USGS page.
ficha.funvisis: Figures from the USGS; FUNVISIS may publish different ones for the same event. Not an early warning system.
